APPROPRIATION (AMENDMENTS) STATUTE No. 03 OF 2017 OF THE SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL
COUNCIL

APPROPRIATION (Amendment) Statute No.03 of 2017 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is passed by theSabaragamuwa Provincial Council on 18.07.2017 and assented to by the Honourable Governor of the SabaragamuwaProvince on 14.08.2017 is hereby published for the information of the public.

2.The limits mentioned in the Advance Account namely 81402, 83101, 84002 and 85301 in the Second Scheduleof the Appropriation Account No. 04 of 2015 as amended by Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 02 of2016 and No. 05 of 2016, is hereby amended as per the first Schedule hereof.
